quotations.old_english: Dysiges folces gumrinca gyden a goddess of the foolish people, of men
quotations.english: a goddess of the foolish people, of men

source_text: gum-rinc, es; m. A man :-- Gódlíc gumrinc a goodly man, Exon. 129a; Th. 495, 7; Rä. 84, 4. Dysiges folces gumrinca gyden a goddess of the foolish people, of men, Bt. Met. Fox 26, 105; Met. 26, 53: Cd. 75; Th. 93, 27; Gen. 1552.
